title: One Man Die For The People

request.style: English, male baritone solo with backing choir, piano, strings, bass, drums, gospel, reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The chief priests met with the Pharisees
They sat in council and asked with care
What are we doing, they questioned deep
This man performs many signs, they said
If he keeps on like this, they feared
Everyone will believe in him
The Romans will come to take away
Both our place and our nation

[Chorus]
It is better that one man die
For the people than the whole nation perish
One man die for the people
Save us from the end of days

[Verse]
One of them named Caiaphas spoke
He was high priest that very year
You know nothing at all, he said
You do not realize the truth
It is better that one man die
For the people than the whole nation perish
He did not say this on his own
But being high priest he prophesied

[Chorus]
It is better that one man die
For the people than the whole nation perish
One man die for the people
Save us from the end of days

[Bridge]
Jesus was going to die for the nation
And not for the nation only
But to gather into one
The scattered children of God

[Chorus]
It is better that one man die
For the people than the whole nation perish
One man die for the people
Save us from the end of days

[Outro]
From that day on they plotted
To put him to death
